description: Real, verbatim SUPERAGENT_CAPTURE_DIR capture (2026-07-28, SDK 0.3.219 / CLI 2.1.219) of a foreground Agent completing and then being resumed in a later turn through SendMessage. The resumed run reuses task_id aa5ac0a289c66aab7 with a new SendMessage tool_use_id. Its background_tasks_changed and task_started frames arrive before the SendMessage acknowledgement, and terminal task_updated/task_notification frames arrive later. Regression guard: the acknowledgement must not complete the resumed run; it stays registered as background work until the terminal task frames.
